dedupe_keys.name: an alternating direction method of multipliers based distributed planning model for natural gas network electricity network and regional integrated energy systems

description: The deposit describes distributed investment planning for coupled gas, electricity and regional energy systems using the alternating direction method of multipliers. It separates decisions among three ownership groups. The provider is Ang Xuan. Coverage: The benchmark combines an adapted IEEE 24-bus system, a Belgian 20-node gas network and three assumed regional energy systems. These are linked study cases, not one measured service area. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: The public description reports convergence experiments but does not establish independent reuse, complete executable contents or a reproducibility test. For simulation it supports comparison of joint and distributed infrastructure-planning formulations. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
